entries.translation: 仓库的默认分支。选择此项可开始不依赖当前分支的新工作。

entries.text: The default branch of the upstream repository. Pick this to start on something new that's not dependent on your current branch.
entries.translation: 上游仓库的默认分支。选择此项可开始不依赖当前分支的新工作。

entries.translation: 此文件存在冲突，必须通过命令行解决。

entries.text: The file was renamed but not changed
entries.translation: 文件已重命名，内容未更改

entries.text: The friendly name shown in the Copilot model picker.
entries.translation: 在 Copilot 模型选择器中显示的名称。

entries.text:
The Git repository appears to be owned by another user on your machine.
      Adding untrusted repositories may automatically execute files in the repository.
      If you trust the owner of the directory you can add an exception for this directory in order to continue.
entries.translation: 此 Git 仓库似乎属于本机的其他用户。添加不受信任的仓库可能会自动执行其中的文件。如果你信任目录所有者，可以将其添加为例外以继续。

entries.text: The repository will be removed from GitHub Desktop:
entries.translation: 以下仓库将从 GitHub Desktop 中移除：

entries.text: The secret is real, I understand the risk, and I will need to revoke it. This will open a security alert and notify admins of this repository.
entries.translation: 此密钥真实有效，我了解风险并将撤销它。此操作会创建安全警报并通知仓库管理员。

entries.text: The secret poses no risk. If anyone finds it, they cannot do any damage or gain access to sensitive information.
entries.translation: 此密钥不构成风险。即使被发现，也无法造成损害或访问敏感信息。

entries.text: There are no uncommitted changes in this repository. Here are some friendly suggestions for what to do next.
entries.translation: 此仓库没有未提交的更改。你可以尝试以下操作。

entries.text: There are uncommitted changes in this repository
entries.translation: 此仓库存在未提交的更改

entries.text: There are uncommitted changes in this repository.
entries.translation: 此仓库存在未提交的更改。

entries.text: There is already a file with this name. Git can only clone to a folder.
entries.translation: 已存在同名文件。Git 只能克隆到文件夹。

entries.text: These icons indicate which repositories have local or remote changes, and require the periodic fetching of repositories that are not currently selected.
entries.translation: 这些图标表示哪些仓库存在本地或远程更改，需要定期获取未选中仓库的更新。

entries.text: These users weren't found and won't be added as co-authors of this commit. Are you sure you want to commit?
entries.translation: 未找到这些用户，他们不会被添加为此提交的共同作者。确定要提交吗？

entries.text: This branch does not exist locally. Deleting it may impact others collaborating on this branch.
entries.translation: 本地不存在此分支。删除它可能影响在此分支上协作的其他人。

entries.text: This branch may have an open pull request associated with it.
entries.translation: 此分支可能关联着尚未关闭的拉取请求。

entries.text: This commit has not been pushed to the remote repository
entries.translation: 此提交尚未推送到远程仓库
此提交将归属于错误的作者

entries.text: This diff contains bidirectional Unicode text that may be interpreted or compiled differently than what appears below. To review, open the file in an editor that reveals hidden Unicode characters.
entries.translation: 此差异包含双向 Unicode 文本，实际解释或编译结果可能与显示内容不同。请使用能够显示隐藏 Unicode 字符的编辑器查看。

entries.text: This directory appears to be a bare repository. Bare repositories are not currently supported.
entries.translation: 此目录似乎是裸仓库，目前不支持裸仓库。

entries.text:
This directory contains a README.md file already. Checking
          this box will result in the existing file being overwritten.
entries.translation: 此目录已有 README.md 文件。勾选此项将覆盖现有文件。

entries.text: This directory does not appear to be a Git repository.
entries.translation: 此目录不是 Git 仓库。

entries.text: This directory does not appear to be a Git repository. Would you like to create a repository here instead?
entries.translation: 此目录不是 Git 仓库。是否在此创建仓库？

entries.text: This folder contains files. Git can only clone to empty folders.
entries.translation: 此文件夹中已有文件。Git 只能克隆到空文件夹。

entries.text: This is used to identify the commits you create. Anyone will be able to see this information if you publish commits.
entries.translation: 这些信息用于标识你创建的提交。发布提交后，任何人都能看到这些信息。

entries.text: This may indicate attackers are trying to steal your data.
entries.translation: 这可能意味着攻击者正试图窃取你的数据。

entries.text: This operating system is no longer supported. Software updates have been disabled.
entries.translation: 此操作系统已不再受支持，软件更新已禁用。

entries.text: This path does not appear to be a valid executable.
entries.translation: 此路径不是有效的可执行文件。

entries.text: This repository is a fork. How do you plan to use it?
entries.translation: 此仓库是派生仓库。你准备如何使用它？

entries.text: This repository is currently only available on your local machine. By publishing it on GitHub you can share it, and collaborate with others.
entries.translation: 此仓库目前只保存在本机。发布到 GitHub 后即可分享并与他人协作。

entries.text: This submodule change cannot be added to a commit in this repository because it contains changes that have not been committed.
entries.translation: 此子模块包含未提交的更改，无法将其更改添加到当前仓库的提交。

entries.text: This will create a stash with your current changes. You can recover them by restoring the stash afterwards.
entries.translation: 此操作会暂存当前更改。之后可通过恢复暂存来找回这些更改。

entries.text: This will discard changes and they will be unrecoverable.
entries.translation: 此操作将丢弃更改，且无法恢复。

entries.text: This will not affect the original repository name on GitHub.
entries.translation: 此操作不会影响 GitHub 上的原始仓库名称。

entries.text: This will take you back to the original branch state and the conflicts you have already resolved will be discarded.
entries.translation: 此操作将恢复原始分支状态，并丢弃已经解决的冲突。

entries.translation: 才能显示 GitHub Desktop 的通知。

entries.text: To help you get Git installed and configured for your operating system, we have some external resources available.
entries.translation: 你可以参考相关外部资料，为当前操作系统安装并配置 Git。

entries.text: Turning this off will not stop the periodic fetching of your currently selected repository, but may improve overall app performance for users with many repositories.
entries.translation: 关闭此选项不会停止定期获取当前仓库的更新，但可能改善仓库较多时的应用性能。

entries.text: Unable to display diff when multiple non-consecutive selected.
entries.translation: 选择多个不连续的提交时，无法显示差异。

entries.text: Unable to load the diff for this file.
entries.translation: 无法加载此文件的差异。

entries.text: Unable to merge unrelated histories in this repository
entries.translation: 无法合并此仓库中不相关的历史

entries.text: Unable to read path on disk. Please check the path and try again.
entries.translation: 无法读取磁盘路径。请检查路径后重试。

entries.text: Unable to reorder. Reordering replays all commits up to the last one required for the reorder. A merge commit cannot exist among those commits.
entries.translation: 无法重新排列。此操作需要重放涉及的所有提交，其中不能包含合并提交。

entries.text: Unable to squash. Squashing replays all commits up to the last one required for the squash. A merge commit cannot exist among those commits.
entries.translation: 无法压缩。此操作需要重放涉及的所有提交，其中不能包含合并提交。

entries.text: Unable to start rebase. Check you have chosen a valid branch.
entries.translation: 无法开始变基。请确认所选分支有效。

entries.text: When enabled, check marks will be displayed along side the line numbers and groups of line numbers in the diff when committing. When disabled, the line number controls will be less prominent.
entries.translation: 开启后，提交时会在差异视图的行号旁显示勾选标记。关闭后，行号控件会更简洁。

entries.text: When enabled, GitHub Desktop will attempt to load environment variables from your shell when executing Git hooks. This is useful if your Git hooks depend on environment variables set in your shell configuration files, a common practice for version managers such as nvm, rbenv, asdf, etc.
entries.translation: 开启后，执行 Git 钩子时会从终端加载环境变量。适用于依赖终端配置的钩子，例如使用 nvm、rbenv、asdf 等版本管理器的项目。

entries.text: When enabled, GitHub Desktop will underline links in commit messages, comments, and other text fields. This can help make links easier to distinguish.
entries.translation: 启用后，GitHub Desktop 会为提交信息、评论和其他文本中的链接添加下划线，让链接更容易辨认。
